context: Two friends catch up on each other’s love lives and big changes (relationships, moving)
purpose: Teach: 恋人/離婚/移転/あちこち/おれ/勿論/ご存知/つくり

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: メイ、久しぶり!おれ最近大学の近くに移転したんだ、引っ越し大変だったよ。
lines.en: Mei, long time no see! I recently moved closer to the university, the move was tough.
lines.style: Warm casual male greeting with slight excitement, hiragana おれ first person, mid pitch

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、そうなんだ!あちこち荷物探して大変そうだったでしょ?
lines.en: Oh really! You must have been searching everywhere for your stuff, right?
lines.style: Soft feminine sympathy with rising teasing intonation, gentle warmth, light laughter throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、本当に。ところでさ、知ってるでしょ、おれずっと彼女いなかったけど、ついに恋人ができたんだよ。
lines.en: Yeah, really. By the way, you know how I hadn't had a girlfriend for ages — well, I finally got one.
lines.style: Bashful casual announcement with proud undertone, slight pause before reveal, mid pitch

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えーっ、本当に!?勿論、応援するよ!どんな人なの?
lines.en: Whaaat, really?! Of course I'll cheer you on! What kind of person is she?
lines.style: Excited high pitched feminine surprise, supportive friend energy, rapid curious questions

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なんか家のつくりが古い感じの喫茶店で出会ったんだ。落ち着いた人だよ。
lines.en: We met at a coffee shop with an old-style build. She's a calm person.
lines.style: Soft nostalgic male recollection, slower pace, fond reminiscing tone throughout line

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいなあ。あのね、ご存知の…じゃなくて、実は私の姉さんが離婚することになって、ちょっと家族がバタバタしてるの。
lines.en: That's nice. Listen, you know — well, actually my older sister is getting divorced, so the family's been a bit hectic.
lines.style: Tone shifts from cheerful to confiding lower register, vulnerable feminine disclosure, soft

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: えっ、それは大変だな…お姉さん大丈夫?何か手伝えることあったら言って。
lines.en: Oh, that's rough... Is your sister okay? Let me know if there's anything I can help with.
lines.style: Concerned softened male voice, dropping volume, genuine supportive friend tone throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとう、レン。優しいね。今度ゆっくり話そうね。
lines.en: Thank you, Ren. You're so kind. Let's have a proper long chat next time.
lines.style: Warm grateful feminine close, slight smile in voice, gentle wrap-up cadence overall
